name: mego-business-suite
description: MEGO Business Suite is a business systsem utilisable by businesses to manage clients, products, services and books related to the company

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd app_frontend && npm install && cd app_backend && npm install
scripts.dev:wait: concurrently -k -r -n BE,FE "npm run dev:app_backend" "wait-on tcp:3002 && npm run dev:app_frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -r -n BE,FE "npm run dev:app_backend" "sleep 5 && npm run dev:app_frontend"
